! Fictitious IOS XE access switch with deliberate misconfigurations - no real device data.
version 17.6
service password-encryption
hostname EXAMPLE-ACCESS-SW1
security passwords min-length 6
enable secret 4 EXAMPLEtype4HashNotReal00000000000000000000
!
interface Vlan10
 ip address 198.51.100.2 255.255.255.0
!
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/1
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 10
!
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/2
!
ip access-list extended USERS-IN
 10 permit ip any any log
!
snmp-server community private view ALL RO
snmp-server community ExampleMonitoring RO UNDEFINED-SNMP-ACL
!
logging 198.51.100.50
ntp server 198.51.100.123
ip ssh version 2
!
line vty 0 15

!
